title: Discord (send messages)
description: Sends a flow's message to a Discord channel through a bot: a message.send connector, the last step of a flow that runs on its own. Text only.
setup_notes: Create an application at discord.com/developers/applications, add a Bot and copy its token. Invite the bot to your server with the Send Messages permission (OAuth2 > URL Generator, scope bot). Turn on Developer Mode in Discord's settings, then right-click the channel and Copy Channel ID. Run Test on its row under Admin > Extensions > Connectors, which posts a short test message. Then put it to use as a flow's message.send step. Its key is given where it is used, under the choice, or under Settings on its row in Admin > Extensions > Connectors.

questions.name: name
questions.label: Connector name
questions.help: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; a flow's step names it.

config.name: channel
config.label: Channel id
config.help: Where messages go unless a flow's step says otherwise (its to input): the long number Copy Channel ID gives.

config.name: bot_token
config.label: Bot token
config.help: Kept with this connection, and sent only to the address it is given for.
